messages:
nina: Quick check — I'm about to land a TF change that lowers inference-sts minReplicas from 4 -> 2 and wires the value into the statefulset. Also switching updateStrategy to RollingUpdate with a partition=1 canary and bumping readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 45s. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/567 :eyes:
omar: @nina what's the motivation for dropping to 2? cost or traffic? also make sure HPA and PDB won't block the scale-down.
nina: Cost + recent qps dip (avg ~60rps). HPA targetcpu=60, hpa.minReplicas currently 2 in HPA but the TF module had a mismatch so the k8s object stayed at 4. This PR syncs module -> helm values -> sts.minReplicas.
raj: If HPA.minReplicas is 2 and you set sts.replicas=2 that's fine, but check the PDB: pdb.inference has minAvailable: 2. Lowering replicas to 2 with minAvailable:2 would make evictions impossible. Either set pdb.minAvailable: 1 or change pdb to maxUnavailable:1.
tara: Also note readinessProbe bump to 45s will slow rolling but should reduce restarts on cold start. Agree with raj on PDB.
omar: For canary, partition=1 is ok but make sure we have enough capacity for the traffic on the 2 remaining replicas. Suggest this rollout plan: 1) stage apply; 2) wait 20m; 3) promote to prod.
raj: I'll stub an alert for podReady < 2 for 10m so we catch regressions quickly.
nina: I'll update the TF module to set module.inference_sts.min_replicas = 2 and pdb.min_available = 1 in the same PR. Terraform diff snippet:
```
module "inference_sts" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.redwood/infra-modules//k8s-statefulset"
  min_replicas = 2
}
resource "kubernetes_pod_disruption_budget" "inference" {
  metadata { name = "inference-pdb" }
  spec { min_available = 1 }
}
```

nina: Helm/STS yaml we'll end up with (excerpt):
```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 1
replicas: 2
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 45
  periodSeconds: 10
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for namespace=prod app=inference-sts sha=abcdef partition=1
omin: (reacts) :thumbsup:

omar: One more thing — secrets wiring: make sure the TF change doesn't rebind `secretMountPath` order. If you changed the volume claim template or secret name, we should run a dry-run.
nina: Not touching secrets or PVCs in this PR. Only min_replicas/pdb/readiness/strategy. Will run `kubectl rollout status sts/inference-sts -n prod` after apply.
raj: I'll be on watch. If things look flaky we can revert partition to 0 and roll back replicas.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 1/3 updated, 2/3 ready (waiting on pod-2 readiness)
 tara: pinging perf infra — if pod startup time > 40s we should consider warming cache.
nina: Thanks all — I'll push the TF change to staging now, run apply, and post back with `kubectl` outputs.
raj: ack, will monitor alerts and be ready to rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: 3/3 updated, 3/3 ready, duration=12m
